overreach: For AI hardware, “S-parameters” matter mainly because AI accelerators and data-center systems depend on very high-speed serial links
AI servers use dense packages, sockets, mezzanine connectors, backplanes, and high-layer-count PCBs
Most AI-related high-speed links are differential
SDD21 insertion loss, SDD11 return loss, SCD/SDC mode conversion
AI boards often use low-loss laminates, advanced package substrates, ABF, CoWoS-related interposers/substrates
Wide frequency coverage and high dynamic range
4-port is often minimum; 8/16+ port or switching is useful
These map directly to AI data-center pain points
review.reason: The passages support several general high-speed PCB/SerDes SI capabilities such as insertion loss, return loss, impedance/TDR, crosstalk, de-embedding, Dk/Df, eye diagrams, and process monitoring.
